messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-3152 triggered: increased gpu.alloc_errors in asia-southeast1. Severity: high. Acknowledged by Alex G.
Alex G.: seeing autoscaler stuck. scale-up requests queued, GCE reports quotaExceeded on GPUs. pods Pending with FailedScheduling.
Alex G.: concrete errors in controller log: `Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA' exceeded for project 12345` and `compute.regionOperations: quotaExceeded`
Sarah P.: metrics — qps steady but tail latency jumping. 95th latency to 2.3s, 99th to 6s. queue_length for generation-reqs jumped from 200 -> 4,100 in 12m.
Irene (SRE): Confirmed k8s events: `FailedCreatePod` x 120 because nodes can't be provisioned. HPA/cluster-autoscaler attempted 8 scale-ups, all returned 403/QuotaErrors from cloud provider.
Jamie L.: paging PD, oncall trying to request emergency quota? who has project IAM to submit quota request?
Mike R.: I have owner. I'll open quota ticket now, trying gcloud request but need region and metric.
Alex G.: customer impact: internal routing shows ~8% of hosted API calls returning 429 throttles and 12% timeouts. Thumb rules: degrade non-critical model variants first.
Alex G.: mitigation attempt 1: temporarily switch traffic away from asia-southeast1 to eu-west2 for non-sensitive workloads. Doing canary route change now.
deploy-bot: :gear: Route update: redirecting 15% -> eu-west2 for service=redwood-gen, rollout-id=rb-237.
Jamie L.: good. Also spin up reserve pool in asia-southeast1 using smaller instance types with 1 GPU each (if quota allows) and enable preemptible GPUs as fallback.
Irene (SRE): tried preemptible path — quota is global per region and also preemptible quota exhausted. we have 0 spare GPU quota in asia-southeast1.
Mike R.: Ticket opened: GCP Quota request CRQ-8754, submitted with justification (production outage). ETA from GCP is unknown, flagged as urgent.
Sarah P.: customer comms: affected customers list includes alpha-inc, beta-saas, and internal staging. Latency for alpha-inc jobs > 30s, many failed. We'll prepare a status note.
Alex G.: immediate mitigation 2: reduce model concurrency (max_tokens/concurrency) on hosted tier to reduce per-pod memory pressure — rolling config now.
Jamie L.: taking over incident while Alex triages quota lane. I'm oncall for next 45m. Alex, leaving notes in thread.
Alex G.: handoff to Jamie L. — context: autoscaler 0->16 desired, cloud returned 403/QuotaErrors, quota ticket opened, traffic 15% shifted to eu-west2, scaling policy lowered. Logs: \n```\ncloud-controller: requestScale: desired=16\ncloud-api: insertInstance: error=quotaExceeded region=asia-southeast1 code=403\nkube-scheduler: FailedCreatePod: insufficient resources: nodes tried=0\n```\nJamie L.: acknowledged. Action list I'm running: 1) expand failover to 40% eu-west2 if queue doesn't drop in 10m; 2) throttle batch-heavy customers via routing rules; 3) escalate PD to GCP SA if no ETA.
Irene (SRE): also enabling temporary caching of prompt prefixes to reduce token regen rate for long-running sessions. May drop quality slightly but reduces load.
Mike R.: GCP replied to CRQ-8754: initial review accepted, quota increase in progress, estimate 2-6 hours. Escalated to enterprise support for faster handling.
Sarah P.: drafting customer-facing status update for engineering->support: short summary, affected regions, mitigation steps (failover + throttling), estimated restoration window tentative 2-6h. Will paste here for review.
Jamie L.: status update reviewed. Publishing now. Continuing to monitor queue and error rates. If eu-west2 saturates, next step is to open cross-region burst to us-central1.
Alex G.: leaving now. Thanks team. Jamie, please update thread with any handoff afterwards.
Jamie L.: will do. current snapshot at 1771505000: queue=2,200 (down from 4,100), 429 rate 6%, timeouts 5%. Progress but still degraded.
Irene (SRE): note action item: follow up with infra to review long-term quota safety (regional reservations, reserved GPUs) and automate cross-region burst policy.
Jamie L.: incident remains open. next update in 10m or on any major change. :thumbsup:
